lead.headline: One claim before 02:00 — and the drop is in your K slot
lead.deck: Coker for Fairbairn tonight, Bass back at K first. Tuten missed a second practice; Murray's hamstring still undiagnosed.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not appear to practise Tuesday, a second straight missed day with the ankle and foot, and plays Thursday night at Baltimore; Kamara is the fallback at 17:45. Kyler Murray, who throws to Jefferson, has a hamstring O'Connell is not sure about for Monday. The owner fixed the Warren bye this morning — Diggs in the FLEX, Gordon at RB, Likely at TE — and also moved Fairbairn into the K slot. That matters tonight: the Coker claim drops Fairbairn, and claims process at 02:00 Wednesday, the last waiver window before the week. Put Bass back at K, then let the claim run. Nothing else on the wire clears the bar: Allgeier inherits a hurt Love's carries but is a coin flip with Kamara, and Mike Washington Jr.'s 25 carries were one coach's call.
